Foreign nationals who studied at a high school in Türkiye, Blue Card holders and TRNC citizens are not eligible for the international quota (YKS only). The MEB equivalence certificate is not required at application. The page states these criteria were applied in 2025-2026 and will be updated for 2026-2027 in line with YÖK regulations.
cmqwkgg3605elnwqo49nzey3g.language: A Turkish certificate is not required to apply. For Turkish-taught undergraduate programmes, a B2 TÖMER certificate (only from Boğaziçi, İstanbul, ITU, Marmara, Yıldız Technical, Hacettepe, METU, Gazi, Ankara, Bursa Uludağ or Bursa Technical universities) or a Yunus Emre Institute certificate exempts you from the university's Turkish proficiency exam; graduates of a 100% Turkish-medium MEB-accredited high school, Turkish citizens and Blue Card holders are exempt. Otherwise you take that exam.

cmqwkgk5l07kwnwqovzw2zjal.overview: The Turkish Language and Literature program delves into the history, development, and nuances of Turkish literary works. It is ideal for those passionate about literature, linguistics, and cultural studies. Students engage in critical thinking, research methodologies, and in-depth analysis of texts, fostering a deep appreciation for Turkish literary traditions.
cmqwkgk5l07kwnwqovzw2zjal.entry: A bachelor's diploma and transcript with at least 60% success are required; ALES is not required of international students. Master's programmes with a thesis require one of the accepted English exam results regardless of the programme's language of instruction. A YÖK Recognition Certificate is required at application for social and applied sciences programmes; for health sciences programmes a YÖK Equivalency Certificate must be submitted before the thesis/project period. Some programmes restrict eligible bachelor's fields (programme criteria PDF dated 8 July 2026).
cmqwkgk5l07kwnwqovzw2zjal.language: Turkish-taught graduate programmes: C1 TÖMER (from the listed universities) or Yunus Emre Institute certificate; graduates of a 100% Turkish-medium bachelor's or master's are exempt; otherwise the university's Turkish proficiency exam.

Bachelor's transcript, with Turkish or English translation
YÖK Recognition Certificate (social/applied sciences) or Equivalency Certificate (health sciences)
